visualCharacteristics: Light Prism-style code panel (#f5f2f0, 4px radius, 16px padding, Consolas-stack 16px/24px) with lightweight token coloring and a black "Copy" button top-right; single-line samples render as an inline code chip without a button.
contentPattern: One row, one cell containing <pre><code> with the code (GraphQL/JavaScript) verbatim. Whitespace is preserved exactly; token coloring is done by a small in-block tokenizer that never alters the text.
usage: Code samples (GraphQL queries, JavaScript) placed inline between tutorial steps.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any preformatted code sample. Author the code as a code block so whitespace is preserved; the Copy button copies the exact code text.
